name: 給与の前払 (salary advance recovery)
order_authority: 労働基準法 art.24(1) proviso: a deduction from wages other than taxes and social insurance needs a written agreement with the majority union or representative (賃金控除協定; company.facts.wage_deduction_agreement); art.25: an advance of wages already earned for an emergency must be paid on request.

name: 社内貸付金 (staff loan repayment)
order_authority: 労働基準法 art.24(1) proviso (賃金控除協定 required) and art.17: a loan may not be set off against wages as a condition of work (前借金相殺の禁止); recovery by deduction is only the employee's voluntary repayment under the agreement.
